---
applyTo: "**/view/**"
---
<!-- Written by `ecs-architecture agents` from the rules of @adobe/ecs-architecture and @adobe/ecs: run it again, never edit. -->

- The view renders the model, binding the DOM or drawing, and connects this feature's widgets: it imports `model`, `elements` and `view`, never `ports`.
- Order its systems against the model's with their own `before`/`after`; the model never names them.
- It finds the fixed elements it drives with a system of its own, from the app's root element, a resource, and exports its plugin, `plugin.<feature>-view.ts`.
- Prefer WebGPU, through `@adobe/ecs-gpu` and render systems (`System.render`), to WebGL and other older APIs: a render system draws from the GPU copy of the components it names, which the world uploads straight from storage as rows change.
